description: Must a job ad or job posting state the salary or pay range, and may an employer ask a candidate about current or previous salary (salary history ban)? Returns one jurisdiction's law on pay in job advertisements and on pay-history questions: the quoted provision, its start date, who it covers, penalties and the official sources with the date they were opened. Not for: checking a specific ad text (check_job_ad), or rules outside pay transparency.

jurisdiction.description: Country, US state or Canadian province code from list_jurisdictions, e.g. AT (Austria), IT (Italy), MT (Malta), PL (Poland), SK (Slovakia), US-CA (California), US-NY (New York), CA-ON (Ontario).

name: get_job_ad_rules
title: Get job-ad pay rules
